Novelty: 5
Justification: The solution is truly groundbreaking. It moves beyond standard "sensitivity training" and "diversity panels" by introducing a robust "Sacred-Secular Taxonomy" that mathematically assigns risk weights to creative assets. The concept of the "Circular Briefing Model"—where local cultural architects brief the global team first—and the "Diaspora-Anticipation Protocol" are highly original approaches to modern borderless social media scrutiny. The inclusion of a "Sacred Pause Protocol" triggered by real-world geopolitical events shows an unprecedented level of forward-thinking crisis management.

Usefulness: 4
Justification: The framework is highly practical and efficient, offering clear workflows, specific approval gates, and defined organizational roles (e.g., Chief Stewardship Officer, Diaspora Sentinel). The platform-specific doctrine and pre-positioned response matrix are immediately actionable. It falls just short of a 5 because the sheer scope—maintaining a permanent Global Cultural Council, year-round Reciprocity Ledger investments, and dedicated real-time command centers—might be prohibitively resource-intensive for any brand outside of the absolute top-tier global conglomerates. 

Flexibility: 5
Justification: The model is highly versatile. It explicitly accounts for regional variations within the same faith (e.g., Hanafi vs. Shafi'i; Tamil vs. Bengali Diwali; Mandarin vs. Vietnamese Tet) and adapts rules accordingly. Furthermore, it provides a sliding scale of approval cadences based on the specific tier of the asset, meaning a purely "Festive Atmosphere" campaign isn't bogged down by the same rigid gates as a "Sacred Core" campaign. It also flexes across multiple digital platforms with tailored rules for TikTok, X, Instagram, and OOH.

Elaboration: 5
Justification: The solution is exhaustively detailed. It leaves no operational ambiguity, providing specific kill criteria for validation gates, exact timelines for crisis responses (e.g., 1-hour internal alert, 4-hour drafted response, 72-hour sacred hold), and precise measurement metrics (e.g., >15% sentiment delta, >90% architect retention). The inclusion of an organizational design chart, a platform doctrine table, and a legacy-vs.-new model comparison matrix demonstrates a comprehensive, end-to-end framework.

Cultural Sensitivity: 5
Justification: The solution is universally appropriate and deeply culturally mindful. It fundamentally respects the communities it seeks to market to by positioning the brand as a "guest" rather than an owner of cultural narratives. It correctly identifies that diaspora communities often have stricter standards than domestic markets, prohibits AI-generated sacred imagery, and explicitly bans the trivialization of fasting as a "hunger emergency" to be solved by a product. The emphasis on year-round reciprocity prevents the extractive, color-washing behavior that typically triggers cultural backlash.
